description: List one "on the Cheap" site's location taxonomy with ids and post counts — the neighbourhoods and surrounding areas it covers. Pass the `site` key for the city (see otc_list_sites). Use an id to filter otc_search_posts geographically — ids are per-site, so use them only against the site they came from. Read-only.

site.description: Which "on the Cheap" city to read. Required — there is no default site. One of: charlotte, denver, atlanta, chicago, columbus, seattle, kansascity, miami, orlando, portland, richmond, southernmaine, triangle, national. Common aliases also work (milehigh, raleigh, rva, southflorida, kc, …). Use otc_list_sites for the full list with the area each one covers.

name: otc_list_locations
title: List a city’s locations
